_comment: pcb-routing skill: load paths of UFI Headless v1.0 (stage B3). Currents: F1/F4 1.5 A hold (USB / C64 PSU in), eFuses U28/U29 TPS25921A I_LIM 1.4-1.7 A (FDD rails, R(ILIM) 150 k), TPS54202 buck up to 2 A, +3V3 about 0.4 A. Widths per the skill table (IPC-2152, 35 um outer, 10 K): 1.5-2 A -> 1.0 mm. Stage A11c replaced F2/F3 + Q1-Q4 by the eFuses: FDD5_S/FDD12_S no longer exist, FDD5_F/FDD12_F are eFuse OUT -> shunt. min_width is checked for EVERY segment of a net, therefore it is set to the narrowest segment the parts allow and the 1.0 mm trunks are verified by the 'paths' entries: (1) U3/U19 TPS2116 are SOT-583 (pads 0.67 x 0.30 mm, 0.5 mm pitch) - every trunk ends in a 0.3 mm neck of at most 3 mm at those pins (VBUS_F, +5V_PRI, +5V_PSU_F, +5V_DRV, +5V); the 1.0 mm trunks are measured up to the cap pad next to the pin (C10, C11, C57) or stated in the README from net_tracks.py. (2) FDD5_F/FDD12_F carry 0.3 mm Kelvin stubs from the shunt pads to the INA180 inputs. (3) BUCK_SW: U2 TPS54202 is SOT-23-6 (0.95 mm pitch), the reviewed 0.6 mm SW link stays. (4) +3V3: LQFP-144 0.5 mm pitch fan-out stubs are 0.2 mm. (5) The distribution nets VBUS/+12V/+5V/FDD_5V/FDD_12V also feed 1 k terminators, dividers, pull-ups and decoupling caps (FDD_5V has 38 pads): their stubs are 0.3 mm. (6) VBUS leaves the USB-C pads A4/B9 and A9/B4 with 0.6 mm for 1.6 mm (the no-connect pads B8/B5 sit 0.7 mm beside them), then 1.0 mm to F1; both pad pairs are tied by a 1.0 mm In2 bar with two vias each. (7) +3V3 is fed by pours (scripts/power_pours.py on the 6-layer board, stage B3) and the plane_fanout.py vias, so no track path can be measured for it; only the segment width is checked.
